gen-megrim-sora: Megrim's hairline strokes and sky-high lowercase give it a sharp, futuristic edge. Sora takes the opposite job, keeping its curves smooth and its letters well parted, a plain sans built for steady reading rather than spectacle.
gen-megrim-space-grotesk: Futuristic and angular, Megrim stretches its lowercase high and cuts each stroke to a thin, measured line. Space Grotesk sits lower and rounder beneath it, a sans with open curves and constant width, so a bigger heading size seems a sensible suggestion.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-amulya:
Amulya looks modern and uncluttered, with generous gaps in its curves.

Mystery Quest brings the old-book charm of its open-jawed curves and tall lowercase, and the sharpest thing about the pair is how far apart those two moods sit.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-plein:
Plein reads reliably, with a clear channel leading into every round letter, so nothing snags the eye.

And Mystery Quest above it adds a nostalgic, bookish voice, which makes a long page feel like a gentle walk rather than a march.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-spline-sans: Mystery Quest has open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, and it earns its keep when set big and short. Spline Sans follows in a plain sans, its bent-tubing strokes all one gauge, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-synonym:
Those open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest away.

It does bookish, nostalgic drama well with its compact ascenders, while Synonym does the dependable work, laying down a constant stripe of ink in a sans-serif with generous curve openings.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out wide, with a deep midsection and thin parts barely slimmer than its stems. Mystery Quest does the bookish, nostalgic storytelling with open-jawed curves, while Aclonica handles the plain sans job of staying out of the way.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-allerta:
Allerta spreads out wide and loose, its prominent x-height giving every line a lot of presence.

And Mystery Quest's compact ascenders and nostalgic curves above would make a longer page feel unhurried, never crowded.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-alumni-sans:
Alumni Sans reads clean and approachable, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height and its c pulled wide open like a bracelet.

Mystery Quest brings bookish nostalgia up top; the body just keeps things friendly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-alumni-sans-pinstri:
Approachable and compact, Alumni Sans Pinstripe runs one flat line weight through every glyph, with oversized lowercase letters beside small capitals under Mystery Quest's nostalgic heading.

Over a longer stretch, its tight word texture reads like fine, steady stitching.
